005package org.wpilib.util;
006
007import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
008
009/** Utility functions for reporting resource usage. */
010public final class UsageReporting {
011  private static final BiConsumer<String, String> DEFAULT_REPORT_USAGE = (resource, data) -> {};
012  private static volatile BiConsumer<String, String> reportUsageImpl = DEFAULT_REPORT_USAGE;
013
014  private UsageReporting() {}
015
016  /**
017   * Reports usage of a resource of interest. Repeated calls for the same resource name replace the
018   * previous report.
019   *
020   * @param resource the used resource name
021   * @param data arbitrary associated data string
022   */
023  public static void reportUsage(String resource, String data) {
024    reportUsageImpl.accept(resource, data);
025  }
026
027  /**
028   * Reports usage of a resource of interest. Repeated calls for the same resource name replace the
029   * previous report.
030   *
031   * @param resource the used resource name
032   * @param instanceNumber an index that identifies the resource instance
033   * @param data arbitrary associated data string
034   */
035  public static void reportUsage(String resource, int instanceNumber, String data) {
036    reportUsage(resource + "[" + instanceNumber + "]", data);
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Sets the implementation used by {@link #reportUsage(String, String)}.
041   *
042   * @param func function called by reportUsage(); pass null to restore the default no-op
043   *     implementation
044   */
045  public static synchronized void setReportUsageImpl(BiConsumer<String, String> func) {
046    reportUsageImpl = func == null ? DEFAULT_REPORT_USAGE : func;
047  }
048}
